passages.title: Brightside Circle
passages.text:
BRIGHTSIDE COFFEE ROASTERS
Introducing the Brightside Circle loyalty program!

Join this month and enjoy:
* A free medium drink after every 8 purchases
* Double points every Tuesday
* A birthday treat of your choice
* Early access to seasonal flavors

Sign up in our app or at any register. Members who sign up by March 31 receive a free tote bag (while supplies last). Points expire 12 months after they are earned. Not valid with other promotions.

questions.q: When can members earn double points?

why.en: The ad says members earn double points every Tuesday.

questions.q: Which benefit is NOT mentioned in the advertisement?

why.vi: Quảng cáo không nhắc giao hàng miễn phí.
why.en: Free delivery does not appear in the list of benefits.

questions.q: What must customers do to receive a free tote bag?

why.vi: "Members who sign up by March 31 receive a free tote bag".
why.en: Members who sign up by March 31 receive a tote bag.

questions.trap: "While supplies last" chỉ là điều kiện hàng còn, không phải điều kiện nhận.

passages.title: Q3 results
passages.text:
To: Marketing Team
From: Olivia Grant, Marketing Director
Subject: Q3 campaign results
Date: October 2

Hi team,

I want to thank everyone for the Q3 campaign. [1] The social media series generated 12,000 new followers, which exceeded our goal by 20 percent. [2] Click-through rates on our e-mail newsletters, however, were lower than expected. We believe the subject lines were too long. [3] For Q4, we will shorten them and test two versions of each message.

Please send me your ideas for holiday promotions by Friday, October 10. [4] We will review them at our meeting on October 14.

Thanks again,
Olivia

questions.q: What is the purpose of the e-mail?
options: To report results and request ideas

why.vi: Thư tóm tắt kết quả Q3 và xin ý tưởng cho kỳ nghỉ lễ.
why.en: The e-mail summarizes Q3 results and asks for holiday ideas.

questions.q: What are team members asked to send by October 10?

why.vi: "send me your ideas for holiday promotions by Friday, October 10".
why.en: She asks for holiday promotion ideas by October 10.

questions.q:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"Long subject lines were often cut off on mobile phones."

why.vi: Câu này giải thích vì sao tiêu đề dài là vấn đề, nên đi sau "the subject lines were too long" tại [3].
why.en: It explains why long subject lines were a problem, so it follows that sentence at [3].

questions.trap: Vị trí [2] nói về tỉ lệ nhấp nhưng chưa nhắc subject line.

passages.title: Banner delivery
passages.text:
Jun Park (9:05 A.M.): Did the printer deliver the banners for the product launch?
Elena Ruiz (9:08 A.M.): Only half of them. The rest will be ready at noon.
Jun Park (9:09 A.M.): Booth setup starts at 1:00. That's tight.
Dev Mehta (9:12 A.M.): I can pick up the second batch myself. The printer is only 15 minutes from here.
Elena Ruiz (9:13 A.M.): That would be a huge help.
Jun Park (9:14 A.M.): Dev, are you sure? You have the client meeting.
Dev Mehta (9:15 A.M.): It's at 11. I'll be back by 12:30.
Jun Park (9:16 A.M.): Perfect. I'll let the setup crew know.

why.en: Ms. Ruiz says only half of the banners are ready.

questions.q: At 9:13 A.M., what does Ms. Ruiz mean when she writes, "That would be a huge help"?
options: She wants to delay the launch
She is worried about the client meeting
She wants Mr. Mehta to pick up the banners

why.vi: Dev vừa đề nghị đi lấy lô thứ hai; câu "That would be a huge help" là cô vui lòng nhận lời đề nghị đó.
why.en: She is welcoming Mr. Mehta's offer to pick up the second batch.

questions.trap: Cô không cảm ơn Jun, vì Jun chỉ nói setup bắt đầu lúc 1:00.

questions.q: When will Mr. Mehta most likely return with the banners?

why.vi: Anh có cuộc họp lúc 11 giờ, hàng sẵn lúc trưa, và nói sẽ "be back by 12:30".
why.en: He has an 11:00 meeting, the banners are ready at noon, and he says he will be back by 12:30.
